question: Who among the following Indian wrestlers became World No. 1 in 65-kg freestyle wrestling in March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bajrang Punia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bajrang Punia became World No. 1 in 65-kg freestyle wrestling in March 2021.**

 
• Bajrang Punia__ won gold in the Men’s freestyle wrestling 65 kg category at the Dan Kolov 2019 wrestling event.
 
• Bajrang Punia is related to Wrestling.
 
• Bajrang Punia belongs to Haryana.
 
• He won the bronze medal at Tokyo Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Yogeshwar Dutt** is an Indian freestyle wrestler.

 
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri by the Government of India in 2013.
 
• He won gold medals at the 2010 and the 2014 Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Sushil Kumar Solanki** is a former Indian wrestler.
 
 
• His 2008 Olympic medal was second for India in wrestling, and the first since Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav's bronze medal at the 1952 Summer Olympics.
